name: Cacamatzin
contribution: The tlatoani of Texcoco, the second most important city of the Aztec Empire.
legacy: Moctezuma II wished to lessen Texcoco's power in favor of greater centralization in Tenochtitlán
image_credit: Manuscript by Fray Bernardino de Sahagún. Illustration by an unknown artist. · Public domain

checks.lead: Cacamatzin (or Cacama) (c. 1483–1520) was the tlatoani (ruler) of Texcoco, the second most important city of the Aztec Empire.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
